title: Great Ziggurat of Ur
summary: King Ur-Nammu began a huge stepped temple tower to the moon god Nanna, estimated at over 30 m tall, at the heart of Ur; his son Shulgi completed it.
why: A landmark of Sumerian temple building under the Third Dynasty of Ur.

notes.problem: Source calls the 30 m height speculative and says Shulgi finished the building.
